entry.name: mcs.gate~
entry.digest: Route a signal to a channel within a multi-channel output
entry.description: Use gate~ to route an input signal at the second inlet to one of several outlets, or to no outlet at all. When there is only one outlet (the default case), it acts as a simple switch. Unlike the Max gate object, any outlet which is not selected outputs a signal composed of zero values. When the gate~ object is created as mcs.gate~ all of its signal outlets are combined into a single multichannel outlet. The behavior of mcs.gate~ is analogous to gate~.

arguments.name: initial-open-outlet
arguments.description: Set the outlet that is initially selected. If 0, all signals are shut off and zero signals are sent out all outlets.
